onboarding.description: Devora is your personal development dashboard. Manage your GitHub issues, pull requests, todos, Git worktrees, and launch Claude agents — all from a single interface. Start by adding a repository below to get going.

hero.tagline: One dashboard, all your dev workflow
hero.subtitle: Manage your GitHub issues, pull requests, and parallel AI sessions from a single unified interface. Built for teams who ship fast.

kanban.title: Issues & Kanban
kanban.desc: Kanban board synced to GitHub Projects V2.
kanban.details: Drag-and-drop issues across status columns, filter by view, and see real-time sync with your GitHub Project boards. Every status change is reflected instantly on both sides.

prs.title: Pull Requests
prs.desc: Track PRs and CI checks across all repos.
prs.details: See all open PRs in one view with live CI status, review requests, and diff stats. Merge with one click using squash merge. No more switching between repos.

parallel.title: Parallel AI Sessions
parallel.desc: Multiple Claude agents on separate branches.
parallel.details: Assign an issue to an agent, it creates a worktree branch and works autonomously. Run several in parallel — each agent tackles its own issue independently with full activity logging.

workspace.title: Unified Workspace
workspace.details: Manage todo lists per repo, browse git branches with commit history, configure agent presets and skills. Everything your team needs without leaving the dashboard.
